title: Research Platform - Buy Value For Black Friday
creator: Sven Carlin
summary: Sven Carlin's short video is a Black Friday promotion for his research platform rather than a stock recommendation — no individual stock call is made. The platform costs $499 per year, and anyone who joins before the end of the year locks that price in forever; from 2027 the price rises to $597 per year, so he frames joining now as effectively a 20% discount, with a 21-day money-back guarantee. He describes the platform as the value-investment pillar of wealth accumulation: global value stocks, a diversified portfolio that is currently 15 value investments and likely to grow toward 20, especially if markets keep falling, with an email sent whenever he makes a trade or publishes research. He says he is now researching the S&P 500, the Swiss stock market and Asian stocks because he senses it is time to do a lot of research for the opportunities that will come, on top of the stocks already in the portfolio. He also mentions his book is out — a big book sold at roughly print-and-ship cost through Amazon, with no discount. He closes by urging viewers not to spend money on stupid things during the discount season.
